data.narrative: Student achieved comprehensive mastery in Module 07, successfully decoupling the public redirect hot path from analytical persistence using an asynchronous Celery and Redis pipeline. The student deterministically reproduced the analytics double-counting bug caused by non-idempotent task retries. The student engineered atomic idempotency using PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT (click_event_id) DO NOTHING, verified graceful queue-down degradation where simulated Redis broker failures never impede 307 redirects, enforced SHA-256 IP privacy hashing, implemented 30-day retention pruning via purge_expired_clicks_task, and verified live end-to-end task consumption with a live Celery worker process. All 10 tests in verify_module_07.py and all checks in verify_module_07_fix.py passed with 100% success.

dimension_scores.observation: Demonstrated deep mastery of asynchronous message queue tradeoffs, prioritizing hot-path redirect latency and uptime over telemetry consistency, while solving at-least-once delivery duplicate risks via idempotent database constraints.
dimension_scores.evidence: Selected Option B in DECIDE; articulated why asynchronous queues protect redirect throughput and why idempotency keys are mandatory for at-least-once brokers.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed a deterministic reproduction script (reproduce_module_07_break.py) simulating worker task redeliveries and proving duplicate row insertion, then validated post-fix deduplication with verify_module_07_fix.py.
dimension_scores.evidence: Observed total_clicks incrementing from 1 to 2 on retried payload; confirmed post-fix status: deduplicated and total_clicks remaining 1.

dimension_scores.observation: Guaranteed privacy compliance by hashing client IP addresses with SHA-256 before enqueuing, and enforced strict multi-tenant authorization on the analytics query endpoint.
dimension_scores.evidence: verify_module_07.py Test 4 confirmed raw IP absent from click_events, and Test 7 confirmed cross-tenant analytics access returned HTTP 404.

dimension_scores.observation: Engineered automated data lifecycle management via purge_expired_clicks_task (30-day retention), and proved resilience during queue-down fault injection drills where 307 redirects continued uninterrupted.
dimension_scores.evidence: verify_module_07.py Test 5 proved 307 redirect succeeded during simulated queue outage, and Test 9 verified purging of expired events.

dimension_scores.observation: Produced clear, highly detailed documentation and reflection records detailing message queue mechanics, idempotency guarantees, and data retention architectures.
dimension_scores.evidence: Compiled complete evidence records in progress/evidence/debugging-module-07-*.md with complete test metrics.
